title.rendered: Kiierr Daily Hair Growth Products – Ultimate Supplements Bundle

content.rendered:
Hair is one of the most important parts of who you are. Every morning you stand in front of the mirror, straightening it, curling it, combing it, massaging it, trying to get more body, trying to get less body–it never seems right. But the one thing that all of us are going to face at some point in our lives–men and women–is the inevitability of hair loss. It may recede in front. It may thin throughout. There may grow a bald spot on the crown of the head. It’s all hair loss, and it all can make us lose some of our self-confidence.

The good news is that there has never been a better time in history to slow or even reverse the action of hair loss. New treatments are cropping up everyday–real, scientific breakthroughs, not snake oil. We at Kiierr harness the great things that science has brought and put it in products that can alter, enhance, or restore your natural hair. We’re not talking about spray-on hair or cultivated hair plugs. We’re talking about real hair growth on your real scalp.

And we’re pleased to announce that right now we’re offering–for a limited time–a bundle of our most impressive and results-producing hair products.

The Kiierr Ultimate Supplements Bundle

The Kiierr Ultimate Supplements Bundle is a total combination of some of the best products that we offer, all for a limited-time low price, to help you understand and experience the true results that you can get from real, effective hair growth treatment. 

The bundle includes:

  • DHT Blocking Hair Growth Vitamins
  • DHT Blocking Shampoo for Hair Growth
  • Conditioner for Hair Growth
  • Biotin Gummies for Hair Growth
  • Saw Palmetto Vitamins

We’ll talk about each of the products in turn, but you may have noticed something about two of the products: they’re DHT Blocking. What is that and what does it mean for you?

What is DHT and Why Do We Block It?

DHT, or Dihydrotestosterone, is a naturally occurring hormone that is a by-product of testosterone–but women, don’t think you’re off the hook! You have testosterone, too, and DHT is present in you as well.

An enzyme in the hair follicle’s sebaceous glands converts testosterone to DHT. This happens in both women and men, even though women have less testosterone than men. DHT is the hormone that is the cause of male pattern baldness and female pattern hair loss. Androgenetic alopecia (the aforementioned conditions) is responsible for hair loss in 50 million men and 40 million women in America, making it the most common cause of hair loss by an order of magnitude. 

To better understand, think of this: all hair goes through a growing process. But during that process, as the hormone begins to work on us (usually as we age) the DHT builds up in the follicles and disrupts the growing cycle. DHT causes the follicles to grow at a slower rate. Hair becomes thinner, more fragile and lightens in color (grays) and eventually the follicles are overwhelmed by the DHT and shut down completely. 

Kiierr DHT Blocking Hair Growth Vitamins

These vitamins work to block that DHT from building up in the follicles so that it won’t impair the growth process. The vitamins include Saw Palmetto, Horsetail Extract, and Zinc which helps to slow or even inhibit the 5-AR enzyme conversion to DHT. Made from all-natural ingredients and enhanced with Vitamin B-6, Folic Acid, and Biotin (which encourages hair growth), this is ideal for both receding hair and thinning hair, as part of a complete Kiierr regimen. 

Kiierr DHT Blocking Shampoo for Hair Growth

This shampoo–which is great shampoo in its own right from a purely utilitarian and scent perspective–also blocks the enzymes which turn testosterone into DHT. Included for hair health are the nutrients Vitamin E, Pro-Vitamin B5, Jojoba Oil, and Collagen Amino Acids. The Zinc PCA helps to regulate the sebaceous glands to block DH, and the Green Tea reduces DHT and Cholesterol and blocks DHT. Kapilarine stimulates hair regrowth and helps your full head of hair to regain its lustre and strength. This shampoo is ideal for both men and women.

Kiierr Conditioner for Hair Growth

This conditioner doesn’t just block hair loss but actually promotes new hair growth through its two active ingredients: Trichogen VEG LS 9733 and DermaPep Pepanagen-S. These stop hair loss and promote new healthy growth, helping receding, thinning and balding hair. (Plus with its peppermint essential oil it smells great!)

Kiierr Biotin Gummies for Hair Growth

Our popular Biotin gummies are formulated with Coconut Oil and Elderberry. These biotin gummies for hair growth provide the support you need for healthy, strong hair!
